name: Can addressing living room trip hazards increase my home's value?

mainEntity.name: Can addressing living room trip hazards increase my home's value?

acceptedAnswer.text: While direct value increase is difficult to quantify, addressing trip hazards can contribute to your home's appeal and marketability. A safer, well-maintained home is often more attractive to potential buyers, especially those with families or elderly relatives. By preventing future repair needs and demonstrating proactive maintenance, you present a higher quality property. It reflects good stewardship and attention to detail, which can be perceived as valuable.
acceptedAnswer.description: While difficult to quantify directly, a safer, well-maintained home free of hazards is more appealing to buyers and reflects good stewardship, potentially boosting marketability.
